title: Implement Gate 0 Codespace Evidence Bridge with GitHub-only final-outcome arbitration
purpose: Collect exact-SHA read-only evidence, seal it, publish only to the verified source conversation, and deterministically elect one cryptographically valid authoritative final outcome without AWS, external services, claims, queues or workflow orchestration.

ownership.rule: Issue #105 defines disjoint exact allowlists. CI/Ops must not modify QA paths and QA must not modify implementation, documentation or work-package paths.

candidateValidation: closed outcome header and JSON shape
arbitration.election: smallest numeric comment_id among all cryptographically valid candidates after convergence
arbitration.executionGuarantee: concurrent read-only executions may occur; global at-most-once execution is not claimed

invariants: All subprocesses use explicit argv and shell=False.
No request can provide a command, argv, shell fragment, script, plugin, path or environment override.
The requested repository equals the canonical GitHub nameWithOwner of the current checkout before the request comment is read.
Every target SHA is a full lowercase 40-character SHA checked before execution, after execution and immediately before POST.
No unrelated GitHub call occurs between the final successful SHA resolution and POST.
Local operations execute only in a disposable clone detached at the requested SHA.
The primary checkout remains unchanged in recorded HEAD, status, refs, index and remotes facts.
Publication targets only the exact verified source issue or pull-request conversation.
Every arbitration read exhausts GitHub pagination and fails closed on read or shape errors.
No marker-only or text-fragment-only comment can become authoritative.
All valid candidates are cryptographically reconstructed and validated before election.
The smallest valid comment_id is the deterministic incumbent after convergence.
A same-digest replay reuses the incumbent without a second authoritative publication.
A different-digest reuse conflicts and cannot displace the incumbent.
A losing concurrent valid result is classified DUPLICATE_FINAL_OUTCOME.
A recorded incumbent that is edited, deleted or invalid produces REGISTRY_INTEGRITY_LOST without silent re-election.
After POST the exact origin is reread exhaustively and authority is recomputed before success.
Ambiguous POST outcomes are resolved only by exhaustive cryptographic reread.
AWS, external services, external databases, new repositories, branches, tags, claim refs, workflows, queues, workers, leases and schedulers are forbidden.
The only remote mutation is creation of the final outcome comment on the exact origin.
Self-stop is disabled for recovery-only, stale, diagnostic, conflicting or duplicate-loser outcomes.
The ordinary runner cannot classify an outcome as GOVERNANCE_DECISION.
requiredEvidence: Exact old and new heads, baseline and merge base are reported.
The implementation delta remains inside the six CI/Ops paths authorized by issue #105.
No QA-owned path is modified by CI/Ops.
Developer checks cover syntax, candidate validation, same-digest and different-digest races, crash recovery, ambiguous POST, immediate SHA movement and deterministic comment-order convergence.
Independent contradictory QA runs on the exact delivered head before Linus or governor review.
adversarialTests: Simultaneous same-job same-digest publication races elect one smallest valid comment_id.
Simultaneous same-job different-digest publication races produce a deterministic conflict for the loser.
Two isolated output roots or Codespaces converge on the same incumbent.
Crash before POST permits safe restart without treating a local file as a global claim.
Crash after POST and ambiguous POST timeout recover through authoritative reread.
Same-digest replay from a fresh output root does not execute or publish again after an incumbent exists.
Stale SHA immediately before POST prevents publication.
Incomplete pagination and transient read failure fail closed.
Edited, deleted, malformed, truncated, unknown-shape and hash-mismatched candidates never gain authority.
Retrieval order does not change the elected incumbent.
No branch, tag, ref, Actions workflow, queue, external service, secret or second repository is used.
nonGoals: Gate 1 sequential queueing or later-stage orchestration.
Generic shell execution, branch creation, commit, push, merge, release or workflow mutation.
Product, runtime, authoring, contract, kit, learner-data or governance-state changes.
CI/Ops authorship of independent QA tests, self-certification or governor acceptance.
independentReview: Independent contradictory QA owns only the four paths authorized by issue #105.
Every correction remains on the existing branch and draft PR #103.
Linus and governor review remain mandatory on one exact QA-covered head before readiness or merge.
rollback: Close draft PR #103 without merge or revert only the bounded OPS-WP-005 commits on the existing branch. No external resource, product state, data migration, branch, tag, workflow or queue exists to remove.
